schemes.official_name: Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), offset mechanism
schemes.publisher: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Government of India
schemes.offers_text: Carbon Credit Certificates for registered projects that reduce, remove or avoid greenhouse gas emissions. Each certificate represents one tonne of CO2e and can be traded on the Indian carbon market platform.
schemes.who: Entities not obligated under the compliance mechanism that register an eligible project in an approved offset sector and follow the published detailed procedure.
numbers_used: 1 Carbon Credit Certificate = 1 tCO2e (BEE carbon market page).

saving.text: tonnes reduced by a registered project x your stated certificate price

inputs.name: tonnes_reduced
inputs.label: Verified reduction from a registered project

inputs.name: price_per_tonne
inputs.label: Certificate price you assume
inputs.note: No official price is published; enter the price and date you rely on.

schemes.official_name: Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), compliance mechanism
schemes.publisher: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Government of India
schemes.offers_text: Obligated entities that reduce emission intensity below their notified target receive Carbon Credit Certificates; entities that miss the target surrender or buy certificates for the shortfall.
schemes.who: Entities notified as obligated entities. BEE lists aluminium, chlor alkali, cement, fertiliser, iron and steel, pulp and paper, petrochemicals, petroleum refinery and textile for gradual transition.
numbers_used: Nine sectors named for gradual transition (BEE carbon market page).

saving.text: tonnes below your notified target x your stated certificate price

inputs.name: tonnes_reduced
inputs.label: Tonnes below the notified intensity target

inputs.name: price_per_tonne
inputs.label: Certificate price you assume
inputs.note: No official price is published; enter the price and date you rely on.

schemes.publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
schemes.offers_text: A subsidy on the cost of Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) certification, plus other incentives listed on the scheme site.
schemes.who: Micro, small and medium enterprises with Udyam Registration; each unit applies for certification separately.
numbers_used: Subsidy on cost of certification: micro 80%, small 60%, medium 50%.
Additional 10% or 5% applies only in stated cases (for example women or SC/ST owned MSMEs); not applied here.

saving.text: certification cost x subsidy rate for your enterprise category

schemes.publisher: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
schemes.offers_text: Term loans for green projects: up to Rs 50 crore, at most 75% of project cost, repayment up to 10 years with up to 18 months moratorium, MCLR-linked interest.
schemes.who: Manufacturers, service providers and MSMEs on the supply or demand side of the green value chain, for activities such as energy efficiency, renewable energy, e-mobility and waste management.
numbers_used: Loan up to Rs 50 crore, maximum 75% of project cost.
Repayment up to 10 years; moratorium up to 18 months.
No interest rate or concession is published on the page.

saving.text: loan amount x (your current rate - the green loan rate you are offered) per year

inputs.name: green_rate_percent
inputs.label: Green loan rate you are offered

schemes.official_name: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), definitive regime
schemes.publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Taxation and Customs Union
schemes.offers_text: From 1 January 2026 EU importers buy and surrender CBAM certificates for the embedded emissions of covered goods. Lower embedded emissions mean fewer certificates for your EU buyer.
schemes.who: Exporters of cement, iron and steel, aluminium, fertilisers, electricity or hydrogen to the EU, through their EU importer. Check the CN code of the exact product.
numbers_used: CBAM certificate price Q3 2026: EUR 82.32, published 5 October 2026 (Price of CBAM certificates page).

saving.text: embedded tonnes avoided x CBAM certificate price

inputs.name: tonnes_reduced
inputs.label: Embedded emissions avoided on goods sold into the EU

inputs.name: price_per_tonne
inputs.label: CBAM certificate price
